text:
Maya: Quick sync on CraftCon next week 3894bb. We have stage slot accepted, booth table confirmed, and 3 staff traveling. Need final call on swag mix, demo network plan, and post-event lead sequence by EOD.

Ravi: Swag proposal: 400 stickers, 200 postcard quick-guides, 120 hoodies (unisex S-XL), 40 demo USBs with sample prompts. Hoodies are pricier but brand-visible. Thoughts? :thumbsup: :tshirt:

Becca: Hoodies are great for retention but hard to ship. How about 80 hoodies, 40 beanies, rest tees? Also agree bump stickers to 600 60a.

Theo: Logistics note 4e6: crate pickup Thu 8am. We need a packing manifest by Wed night. Created a draft checklist here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/CRAFT-ops (edit access).

Maya: I'll defer final numbers to Becca + Ravi. Can you both confirm by 3pm? Ops needs order window.

Ravi: Confirmed: stickers 600, postcards 200, tees 100, hoodies 80, beanies 40, USB demos 40. Ordering now.

Ava: Stage talk: accepted for "Scaling inference on product timelines". I need 2 benchmark callouts and a 60-second demo clip. Benchmarks short: median p95 gen latency 90ms (hosted, 8k), effective cost/1k tokens $0.19 after batching, live canary rollback success 99.5%.

Becca: Copy direction for postcards: lead with "Ship predictable inference" then 3 bullets: latency, cost, rollback. Front side QR -> /events/craftcon, backend tag: craftcon-2024.

Maya: For QR routing we should tag leads in HubSpot and auto-assign to SDR_Panel_A. Ava, make sure the demo includes the live cost slider so we can show tradeoffs (batch size / quantization).

Theo: Network Q: venue Wi4F6 reported to be spotty last year. Ops recommends primary wired uplink + 5G backup. Shall we rent a 5G router or use staff hotspots?

Ava: Rent a 5G router from local vendor + staff hotspots as triple backup. Demo pre-cache prefixes and also include a recorded fallback demo video. Always rehearse fallback messaging: "we have cached/recorded walk-throughs to show how routing & caching keeps UX stable."

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar & post-event cadence templates are at /marketing/templates/post-event-cadence. Suggested flow: Day0 social recap, Day1 thank you + slides, Day4 benchmark deep-dive, Day10 offer trial + demo office hours.

Becca: Post-event follow-up draft: Short thank-you, 3 benchmark bullets, link to the code repo and trial signup, CTA: "Book a 20-min sandbox". We'll A/B test subject lines ("Thanks for stopping by" vs "See Redwood Inference in action").

Maya: Who's owning lead routing after the event? We need HubSpot view + SDR assignment rules.

Ravi: I'll implement routing: tag==craftcon-2024 => owner=SDR_Panel_A, else goes to marketing queue. Also add a priority rule: if attendee indicated interest=trial on form => immediate notification to SDR slack channel #sdr-urgent.

Ava: Can someone QA the demo script Mon 4pm? I want a dry run with the recorded fallback and the live demo.

Becca: I'll QA copy for postcards and hoodies art by Mon noon. Hoodies art file in /marketing/brand/craftcon-assets.

Theo: Packing manifest (please confirm quantities):
```
Crate 1: 2x demo laptops, 1x 5G router, 1x wired switch, 2x portable displays
Crate 2: swag: stickers x600, postcards x200, tees x100, hoodies x80, beanies x40
Crate 3: USB demos x40, chargers, power strips x6, banner stands
Misc: gaffer tape, toolkit, spare laptop battery, covid kits
```

Maya: All good. Ops please ensure labels match crate manifest and courier pickup is Wed 8am.

Ravi: Swag order placed (#RC-7721) ETA Mon to office. I'll move to packing once delivered.

Ava: Rehearsal confirmed Mon 4pm. Invite sent to Maya, Ravi, Becca, Theo.

Becca: Postcard print approved. Hoodies: need final size split by Tue noon.

Maya: Final reminders: 1) Social clip for Day0 4f9: Ravi to make a 25s trailer (logo, 15s demo highlight, CTA). 2) Lead form fields: email, company, role, interested in (trial/pilot/partner), opt-in. 3) Post-event cadence owner: Becca.

Ravi: On social clip. Will use assets in /marketing/brand/craftcon-assets. Need approved voiceover line: "See how we make inference predictable for product teams."

ops-bot: All tasks with due dates assigned in Asana under project: CraftCon-2024.

Maya: Thanks team 680. If no objections, we'll ship crates Wed and proceed.

Ava: Signed off.

Ravi: Signed off.

Becca: Signed off.
